subject: Re: SOC 2 re-audit scheduling, 18-month retention request, and expansion cadence
messages:
From: Sara Connors <sara.connors@novushealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Wu <alex.wu@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: SOC 2 re-audit and retention window

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding support last quarter. Novus is beginning our SOC 2 re-audit prep and we wanted to confirm Redwood's current posture and a couple of asks that will affect the renewal:

- We need a formal re-attestation timeline for the upcoming Type II review (audit window: 2027-07-01 to 2027-07-15). Can you confirm Redwood's availability for evidence collection during that window?
- Our internal security requires an 18-month log retention window for audit data (vs our current 12-month expectation). Can you confirm whether Redwood can extend retention to 18 months and what that means for cost/SLA?
- Please provide a list of the exact artifacts your SOC 2 team will need (examples: audit logs, configuration snapshots, access lists, change history) and a template for log exports.

We're looking to finalize terms and any amendment to the master services agreement by mid-May. Can you get me a draft amendment and a short schedule for evidence handoff?

Appreciate it — copying Procurement for scheduling.

Best,
Sara Connors
CISO, Novus Health
Sara.Connors@novushealth.com

Attachments: audit_requirements_v2.pdf

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@novushealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:32:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-audit and retention window

Hi Sara — thanks for the heads up.

Short answer: yes, we can support evidence collection during the July window and extend retention to 18 months, but there are two practical items we should align on:

1) Retention implementation: we can enable an 18-month audit-log retention profile for your account. That change requires a brief configuration update and a storage uplift; we shadow costs in billing as an "audit-retention" line item.

2) Evidence package: attached is a log export template (log_export_template.csv) and our updated guidance (audit_requirements_v2.pdf). For the July window we'll need:
   - System event logs (auth/authz, infra changes) for the last 18 months
   - Configuration snapshots for production model endpoints in scope
   - Access lists and admin activity reports
   - Change history for service accounts

Proposed next steps:
- I will schedule a 30-minute kickoff with your security and procurement teams to confirm systems in scope and data transfer method. Available slots: 2027-04-28 14:00 or 2027-04-29 10:00 (PT). Please pick one.
- Marissa and Ben, can you prepare an amendment draft and a pricing summary (retention uplift + estimated egress/export cost) by Friday 2027-04-23?

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Attachments: log_export_template.csv, audit_requirements_v2.pdf

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 12:05:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 re-audit and retention window

Internal note — forwarding Novus request. Key asks to cover in the amendment and quote:

- 18-month retention profile (billing: per-GB-month uplift).
- A one-time evidence-transfer assistance task (we typically charge flat effort for large exports).
- SLA language confirming support window for 2027-07-01 to 2027-07-15 and named contacts for evidence delivery.
- Opportunity: Novus is expanding product usage and has signaled interest in predictable throughput for large exports; suggest we propose a Dedicated burst add-on ("Dedicated Export Tier") that includes higher egress IOPS and priority export jobs.

Can you draft: (a) amendment_draft.docx with proposed terms, (b) a short pricing table (retention uplift $/GB-month, Dedicated Export Tier monthly), and (c) a runbook for evidence transfer?

Ben — can you confirm whether the retention change introduces any compliance/residency blockers?

-JL

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 re-audit and retention window

Thanks — drafting now. Preliminary commercials for Novus (ballpark):

- Retention uplift: $0.015 per GB-month for the incremental 6 months (applies to stored audit artifacts beyond current baseline).
- One-time evidence-transfer assistance: $1,750 (includes 6 hours of engineering support + validated export).
- Dedicated Export Tier: $4,500/month for required throughput (includes priority queueing and 4x export concurrency).
- Seat increase: suggest +5 analyst seats under current enterprise seat pricing; addendum will propose prorated seat charge for remainder of annual term.

I'll attach an amendment draft and mark the change log for legal. DocuSign link when ready; routing will include Novus Procurement and our Legal.

Attaching: amendment_draft.docx

-Marissa
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Novus Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Connors <sara.connors@novushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-audit and retention window — formal quote request

Hi Jasmine / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Two quick clarifying items before we route to our legal team:

1) Does the retention uplift change data residency or cross-border transfer obligations? Novus keeps PHI in US-only regions and we need to ensure no EU routing or non-US backups without explicit consent.
2) Can you provide the formal pricing table and an estimated effective date for the retention change so we can budget for May billing?

If possible please send a single PDF summary (amendment + pricing table + implementation schedule) we can attach to the renewal packet.

Regards,
Novus Procurement
procurement@novushealth.com

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@novushealth.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 08:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-audit scheduling, 18-month retention request, and expansion cadence

Hi Sara / Procurement team — following up with everything bundled.

- Amendment draft (amendment_draft.docx) is attached; it includes the retention uplift line item and seat/pricing details. We've confirmed the retention profile will remain US-region only for Novus unless you request multi-region backups. I'll note that explicitly in the amendment.
- Pricing summary: included as page 2 of the amendment. Implementation: config toggle and storage policy can go live on 2027-05-03; first billing impact will appear on the May invoice (prorated).
- Evidence handoff/runbook: we'll coordinate a kick-off on 2027-04-29 10:00 PT (per your earlier note) — invite sent. During the July audit window our SRE team will provide a dedicated contact and we will deliver exports through a signed SFTP endpoint or secure Drive link per your preference.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/novus-rdw-amendment/ZXNf123
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Next steps: please route the amendment to legal and sign via DocuSign if the terms look good. Marissa — please prepare the one-page PDF summary and finalize the runbook so I can attach to the procurement packet.

Thanks — Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Attachments: amendment_draft.docx, audit_requirements_v2.pdf, log_export_template.csv
